description: This file is a shell script for performance testing of Git operations such as read-tree and status. It sets up a repository environment, configures sparse checkout, and runs performance tests related to repository index and tree traversal performance.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up a default test repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a success condition for a test case.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs the performance test with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks completion of the test script.
